## Fostering Innovation & Entrepreneurship

The Institution's Innovation Council (IIC) at MGIT promotes a culture of innovation, creativity, and entrepreneurship among students and faculty.

## About IIC

Promoting innovation and entrepreneurship at MGIT

## Institution's Innovation Council

The Institution's Innovation Council (IIC) is a platform established by the Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology to promote innovation and entrepreneurship among faculty and students.
The IIC focuses to promote innovation, creativity, and entrepreneurship among students and faculty by building a strong innovation ecosystem and aims to nurture ideas into startups, build industry linkages, enhance innovation skills, support women innovators, and strengthen MGIT's participation in national innovation activities.

## Innovation & Entrepreneurship Development

Fostering a culture of innovation and nurturing entrepreneurial mindset among students.

## Incubation & Start-up Promotion

Supporting the development of startups from ideation to commercialization.

## Industry Institute Interaction

Building strong connections between academia and industry for mutual growth.

## Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)

Creating awareness and facilitating protection of intellectual property.

## Functions of IIC

How we foster innovation and entrepreneurship

## Foster Innovation Culture

Foster a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship on campus through various initiatives, workshops, and events.

## Organize Activities

Organize various innovation-related activities and events for students and faculty to showcase their talents.

## Provide Mentorship

Provide mentorship and guidance to aspiring entrepreneurs and innovators at various stages of their journey.

## Build Partnerships

Build and maintain partnerships with industry, government, and other stakeholders to create opportunities.

## Promote Development

Promote innovation and entrepreneurship as a means of social and economic development in the community.

## Enhance Recognition

Increase visibility and reputation for the institute through successful innovation and entrepreneurship outcomes.
